targets.description: Existing VAIXLNS runtime health API; URL must be explicitly configured.
Requires a separately deployed health adapter matching this proposed contract; the repository runtime core is not assumed to expose HTTP.
Configuration-only remote server target; expected identity must be pinned by the operator before a request is sent.
NEXENT web health endpoint; URL must include /api/health and be explicitly configured.
Kept separate from NEXENT until repository identity and service ownership are explicitly reconciled.

invariants: No request is made unless endpoint and explicit probe enablement are present.
Missing expected service identity prevents a request.
Remote cleartext HTTP, credentials in URLs, query strings, and redirects are rejected.
Only bounded JSON objects with exact service identity and a typed healthy signal produce HEALTHY.
Tokens, full endpoints, and raw response bodies are never copied to the report.
Probe success does not grant capability or production admission.
